Definition: an ankle (as a protuberance or joint)
BiblicalUsage: The ankle is the joint God steadies: thou hast enlarged my steps under me, so that my feet did not slip, in David's song and in the psalm alike.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the steady ankle as the picture of a walk God holds up, step by step.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
